title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Ready
summary: We have officially launched the enhanced Spyglass tool, bringing powerful new insights to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded files with new management tools that allow you to upload, remove, download, and customize their display right within the editor.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap provides a transparent, easy-to-understand overview of our recent accomplishments, upcoming features, and future innovations.

title: Redesigned Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've meticulously redesigned our checkboxes to be larger, effortlessly draggable, and visually integrated, empowering you to manage your tasks with greater ease and precision.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a more fluid and intuitive collaboration workflow, making teamwork effortless and productive.

title: Smarter Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items with enhanced visibility and integrated search results.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to announce comprehensive international language support, bringing Noeko to users around the world.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We're opening Noeko's codebase to empower users with maximum control and direct involvement in shaping the project's future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your knowledge base like never before with enhanced filtering and integrated workflows in the dynamic Constellation view.

title: Smart Search & Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Take control of your knowledge with an enhanced search experience, allowing you to filter by tags, date ranges, and connections, then save your tailored results as custom collections for effortless access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Explore your interconnected ideas and information with versatile new display options that adapt to your workflow, making note organization more intuitive and interactive.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Premium Features

title: Stunning New Themes and Visual Refinements
summary: We are enhancing our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new styles to offer a more personalized and visually engaging experience for every user.

title: Smarter Greetings for Your Day
summary: We're enhancing our greetings to precisely reflect the time of day, ensuring a consistently accurate and welcoming experience for every user.

title: Streamlined Tag Management

title: Unlock More Content Types
